title: Active survey instrument assignment
description: Runtime shape of the active instrument set (directive §22). Modelled as a Dataverse table even though the prototype holds it in a collection. THIS is the authoritative source of the currently valid instrument set — audit/history records are NEVER consulted to satisfy current capability coverage (§4.6).

segmentId.description: The technician segment. A handover starts a new segment; the incoming technician's instrument set is recorded separately (§35).

components.description: One entry per component of the system. Primary and probe state is held separately — never concatenated into one ambiguous string (§15).

calibrationDue.description: CALIBRATION DUE date — the field is labelled 'Calibration due', never 'Cal current' (§17).

background.description: Background is held per component AND per capability, with its unit. Independent Alpha, Beta/Gamma and EC backgrounds are never collapsed into one generic value (§4.8). Background is stored alongside the raw reading and is NEVER automatically subtracted (§53).

activeTo.description: Null while the assignment is current. Set when the assignment is replaced — the record itself is retained, never deleted or overwritten (§24).

status.description: Withdrawn = removed without replacement (e.g. pre-use fail before use). Replaced = superseded by replacementAssignment.

replacementOfAssignmentId.description: Set on the NEW assignment, pointing at the one it replaces. Add Instrument leaves this null — Add and Replace are distinct operations (§4.7, §23, §24).

reason.description: Mandatory for Replace; null for Add.

readingAssociations.description: Readings taken under this assignment. Replacing an instrument never re-points existing readings — historical readings stay with the assignment that produced them (§24).

dispositionId.description: For a Fail: the identifier of the review exception raised. A post-use failure is NEVER created with Status='Resolved' (§4.4) — disposition is explicit and recorded separately.
